openerText: Thanks for connecting Shrey, and yeah, let's catch up soon. Quick bit of context first. I run an agency that helps small businesses turn website visitors into actual bookings. That is exactly the kind of thing we sort out. Maybe it is something we can catch up on?
research: vanasva.com is a small nature-led wellness retreat near Nuremberg, Bavaria (founded 2026), co-founded by Shrey Pandey and his husband Chetan Dhi. Verified live site: three programs (Weekend Retreat 565 EUR+ seating 8 guests, Innehalten 4hr intro 95 EUR, Zeit fuer Sie gentle yoga for older adults). Strong brand and storytelling (Shrey is a professional comms/brand storyteller), real 5-star Google reviews. Honest gap = booking friction: no live dates or calendar, every 'Reserve Your Spot' CTA just opens an email. For an 8-seat retreat that email-and-wait gap loses ready guests. Angle = Optimise/Grow (add real dates + reserve-and-pay flow). He replied warmly to the connect note ('Sure thing, lets catch up sometime', AI interest level 5). English opener sent 2026-09-02.
